name: P-StreamRec
description: P-StreamRec is a self-hosted recorder for Chaturbate, CAM4, and m3u8/HLS live streams, with a web interface for discovery, following, live watch, recordings, password protection, optional account login, recording segmentation, and automatic MP4 conversion.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Stores the database, sessions, thumbnails, cookies, original TS recordings, and converted MP4 files.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Web interface port. Host port defaults to 7399; container port: 8080.
